1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Suri Rumah (Perbekalan) 2024.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2024

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi dua puluh dua juta

satu ratus lapan belas ribu ringgit (RM22,118,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang

Keselamatan Sosial Suri Rumah bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

Skim Keselamatan Sosial Suri Rumah bagi tahun 2024 adalah dengan ini

dibenarkan bagi maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 13,576,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 5,515,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 239,000

Perbelanjaan lain 247,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 2,541,000

JUMLAH 22,118,000

 SIM CHEE KEONG

Menteri Sumber Manusia

HOUSEWIVES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2022

HOUSEWIVES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 54(1) of the

Housewives' Social Security Act 2022 [Act 838], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Housewives' Social Security

(Supply) Regulations 2024.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2024

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding twenty-two million

one hundred and eighteen thousand ringgit (RM22,118,000) from

the Housewives' Social Security Fund for the expenditure on administration

of the Housewives' Social Security Scheme for the year 2024 is hereby

authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 13,576,000

Supplies and services 5,515,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 239,000

Other expenditures 247,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 2,541,000

JUMLAH 22,118,000

Made 7 February 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/1/31/7(6); PN(PU2)765/JLD.2]

 SIM CHEE KEONG

Minister of Human Resources
